title: Windows Server 2025 must prevent attachments from being downloaded from RSS feeds.
check_content:
If the following registry value does not exist or is not configured as specified, this is a finding:

Registry Hive: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE
Registry Path: \SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Feeds\

Value Name: DisableEnclosureDownload

Type: REG_DWORD
Value: 0x00000001 (1)
fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Windows Components >> RSS Feeds >> Prevent downloading of enclosures to "Enabled".
VulnDiscussion: Attachments from RSS feeds may not be secure. This setting will prevent attachments from being downloaded from RSS feeds.
